title: Prediction of Hypotension Events with Physiologic Vital Sign Signatures in The Intensive Care Unit
summary: Specific clinical prediction of observed ICU hypotension, with operational alert burden and temporal validation, qualifies as retrospective clinical prediction validation. Preserve single-center limitation and absence of impact study. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: MIMIC-III retrospective ICU data; RF on minute-level vital signs/30-minute overlapping windows predicts initial hypotension (5 of 10 readings SBP≤90 and MAP≤60); temporal split validation. Cohort 1,307 subjects/1,580 stays with events and 1,619/2,279 without; AUROC 0.88 at 60 min, sensitivity 92.4% with 0.79 alerts/subject-hour. Single-center existing-data prediction; not evidence alerts improve outcomes.
